content: machinery/client: New(ctx, ...OptionFunc). Options: WithConfig, WithConfigContext, WithEndpoints, WithTLSConfig, WithGRPCDialOptions, WithUnixSocket, WithCluster, WithContextName. Client struct exposes MachineClient, TimeClient, ClusterClient, StorageClient, InspectClient, ImageClient, DebugClient, LifecycleClient, and COSI of type cosi state.State. Node targeting is via context metadata: client.WithNodes(ctx, nodes...) aggregates responses, client.WithNode(ctx, node) proxies a single node unprocessed. Close() and Conn() manage lifecycle. One Client = one gRPC ClientConn to an endpoint; node fan-out is metadata, not extra conns. pkg/machinery is its own Go module (github.com/siderolabs/talos/pkg/machinery, go 1.26.7), separate from the heavy root module.
